mergedParams.userDescription: Gentle 'overshoot' effect, text slides in and settles back softly. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Gentle Overshoot - Soft Slide & Settle Text Animation

prompts.prompt: Create a gentle 'overshoot' typography preset where text slides in from the right with momentum, overshoots its final position by 10-15%, then settles back softly like a pendulum coming to rest. Think of it like a video editor's 'ease out back' curve - the text should accelerate smoothly, pass through its target position, then gently rebound and settle. The overshoot should feel organic and fluid, like a physical object with weight coming to rest. Use a single TextAtom within a BaseLayout container, applying a custom keyframe effect that combines translateX animation with subtle scale changes during the overshoot phase (scale up to 1.02 during overshoot, then settle to 1.0). The settling motion should have a slight secondary bounce at 5% amplitude to add realism.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center' containing a TextAtom. Create a generic keyframe effect with AnimationRange[] for translateX: start at 120% (off-screen right), overshoot to -15% at 60% progress, bounce back to 2% at 80% progress, and settle to 0% at 100%. Add a subtle scale effect: 0.95 at start, 1.02 during overshoot (60% mark), 0.99 during bounce-back (80%), and 1.0 at rest. Use 'cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)' for the overshoot easing. Total animation duration: 0.8-1.2 seconds relative to parent. Apply will-change: transform for GPU acceleration. Consider creating an internal effect preset called 'gentle-overshoot' for reusability across multiple text elements.

prompts.prompt: Design a typography preset with a soft 'elastic settle' effect where each word in a caption slides in independently with staggered timing, creating a wave-like motion across the text. Imagine editing a title sequence where words flow in like gentle waves, each word slightly pushing the next. The overshoot should be subtle and elegant - think of a slow-motion shot of silk fabric settling after being thrown. Each word should have its own timing offset based on its index, creating a cascading effect. The overshoot amplitude should vary slightly per word (8-12%) to add organic variation. Include a very soft blur during motion that clears as each word settles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with containerProps.className='flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 px-8'. Parse caption data to create individual TextAtom components for each word. Implement staggered animations using word index * 0.1 seconds delay. Each word gets a generic keyframe effect: translateY from -30px with blur(2px), overshoot to 5px at 70% progress, settle to 0px. Add opacity fade from 0 to 1 during first 30% of animation. Use 'spring' easing type for natural physics. Total duration per word: 0.6 seconds + stagger delay. Apply transform-style: preserve-3d to container for depth. Consider using childrenProps to apply consistent text styling across all word atoms. Set fitDurationTo: 'children' to ensure proper timing inheritance.

prompts.prompt: Build a minimalist 'magnetic settle' typography preset where text appears to be magnetically pulled into position, resisting slightly before snapping into place. Picture a video edit where text elements are attracted to an invisible force field - they accelerate quickly, slow down as they approach, overshoot slightly due to momentum, then get pulled back into perfect alignment. The effect should feel like there's invisible tension holding the text. Add a subtle rotation during the overshoot phase (2-3 degrees) that corrects as the text settles, suggesting the text is fighting to orient itself properly.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center'. Single TextAtom with combined transform effects. Create keyframe animation: translateX from 100vw to -8% (overshoot) to 0, rotate from 0 to -3deg to 0, scale from 0.9 to 1.03 to 1. Use custom cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) for magnetic pull feel. Duration: 0.7 seconds relative timing. Add subtle box-shadow during motion: '0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' fading to none. Apply backface-visibility: hidden for smoother rendering. Consider adding a very subtle skewX during overshoot (-1deg) for additional dynamism. Use transform-origin: center for rotation pivot.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'breathing settle' preset where text expands and contracts like it's taking a deep breath before settling. Envision a cinematic title that fills with air, holds for a moment at peak expansion, then exhales into its final position. The overshoot here is in scale rather than position - the text grows beyond its target size, creating a sense of anticipation before relaxing. Layer in a subtle letter-spacing animation that expands during the 'inhale' and contracts during the 'exhale'. This creates a sophisticated, almost meditative quality perfect for elegant titles or quotes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full grid place-items-center'. TextAtom with multi-property keyframe effects. Animation sequence: scale from 0 to 1.15 (overshoot) to 1, opacity from 0 to 1, letterSpacing from -0.05em to 0.15em to 0.02em. Use 'ease-in-out' for first half (inhale), 'cubic-bezier(0.55, 0.055, 0.675, 0.19)' for exhale. Total duration: 1.2 seconds. Add a subtle brightness filter: brightness(1.2) during peak expansion, settling to brightness(1). Consider using fontSize animation as well: start at 0.9em, peak at 1.1em, settle to 1em. Apply text-rendering: optimizeLegibility for clean scaling.

prompts.prompt: Develop a 'pendulum drop' typography preset where text swings in from above like a pendulum, overshooting horizontally as it reaches the bottom of its arc, then gently swaying to rest. Think of filming a sign swinging on chains - it drops down, swings past center due to momentum, then oscillates with decreasing amplitude until still. The text should have realistic physics with proper arc motion. Include a subtle perspective tilt during the swing to enhance the 3D effect. Perfect for playful, dynamic titles that need personality.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden perspective-1000'. TextAtom with transform-origin: top center. Complex keyframe animation combining: translateY from -100% to 10% to 0, translateX following sine wave pattern (0 to 15% to -8% to 3% to 0), rotate pendulum motion (-15deg to 10deg to -5deg to 2deg to 0). Duration: 1.5 seconds with longer settle time. Add rotateX for perspective: 0 to -5deg to 0. Use physics-based easing with custom curve. Apply transform-style: preserve-3d. Consider adding a subtle text-shadow that moves opposite to the swing direction for depth. Include opacity fade-in during first 20% of animation.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'typewriter overshoot' preset where text appears character by character with each letter slightly overshooting before settling, creating a mechanical yet organic typing effect. Imagine a high-speed camera capturing vintage typewriter keys striking paper - each character punches forward, rebounds slightly, then settles into place. The overshoot should be sharp and quick, like the mechanical snap-back of a typewriter mechanism. Add a subtle shake to the entire text block when each new character appears, simulating the vibration of the typewriter.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='flex items-center justify-start font-mono'. Parse text into individual character TextAtoms. Each character animates with: scale from 0 to 1.3 (sharp overshoot) to 1, translateY from -5px to 2px to 0, opacity from 0 to 1. Stagger delay: index * 0.05 seconds for typewriter rhythm. Duration per character: 0.2 seconds with 'cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.6, 0.32, 1.6)' for mechanical snap. Add container shake effect: subtle translateX random between -1px and 1px on each character appear. Consider adding a brief brightness(1.5) flash on each character's initial appearance. Use monospace font via className='font-mono' for authentic typewriter look.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'liquid settle' preset where text flows in like viscous liquid, overshooting with a ripple effect before settling into a stable form. Picture pouring honey that pools and spreads before finding its level - the text should have that same fluid quality. The overshoot creates wave-like distortions that propagate through the text. Use skew and scale transforms to simulate the liquid deformation during motion. This creates an organic, almost alive quality perfect for creative, artistic presentations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full flex items-center justify-center'. TextAtom with complex transform chain. Keyframe sequence: translateY from -50px with scaleY(0.5) and skewX(10deg), through scaleY(1.2) and skewX(-5deg) at overshoot, settling to scaleY(1) and skewX(0). Add wave distortion using scaleX: oscillate between 0.95 and 1.05 during motion. Duration: 1 second with 'cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95)' for liquid flow. Apply filter during motion: blur(0.5px) and contrast(1.1). Consider adding multiple TextAtoms for each word with slight timing offsets (0.05s) to create ripple propagation. Use will-change: transform, filter for smooth animation.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'bounce and settle' preset optimized for impactful caption keywords, where important words bounce in with energy before softly settling. Think of a basketball's motion when dropped - multiple decreasing bounces before coming to rest. The initial impact should be strong and attention-grabbing, with each subsequent bounce having 50% less amplitude. Use the caption metadata to identify keywords and apply stronger overshoot effects to them while regular words have gentler motion. This creates visual hierarchy through animation dynamics.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-end justify-center p-4'. Parse caption.words array, checking word.metadata.keyword flag. For keywords: translateY animation with 4 bounce keyframes (100%, -30%, 15%, -5%, 0) and scale pulses (0.8, 1.2, 1.1, 1.05, 1). For regular words: simpler 2-bounce pattern. Duration: keywords 0.8s, regular 0.5s. Use 'spring' easing with different tension values. Apply color/fontSize based on metadata.impact scores. Stagger based on word.timing.relativeStart. Consider adding glow effect (text-shadow) to keywords during peak bounce. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' to accommodate varying word timings.

prompts.prompt: Develop a 'soft glide' preset where text glides in smoothly with minimal but perfectly controlled overshoot, like a figure skater coming to an elegant stop. The motion should feel effortless and graceful, with the overshoot being barely perceptible but adding crucial organic feel. Think of high-end motion graphics where subtlety is key. The text should decelerate smoothly, pass its mark by just 3-5%, then ease back with buttery smoothness. Include a subtle fade and slight blur during motion that clears as the text settles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center antialiased'. TextAtom with refined animation. Keyframes: translateX from 60px to -3px to 0, opacity from 0 to 1 (complete by 40% progress), filter from blur(4px) to blur(0). Duration: 0.6 seconds with custom 'cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)' for smooth deceleration. Very subtle scale: 0.98 to 1.01 to 1. Apply text-rendering: geometricPrecision for crisp rendering. Consider adding a subtle brightness animation: 0.9 to 1.05 to 1. Use GPU-accelerated properties only (transform, opacity, filter). Perfect for professional, minimalist designs.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'spiral settle' preset where text spirals in with a corkscrew motion, overshooting both position and rotation before unwinding into place. Imagine a leaf falling and spinning, catching air currents before landing - the text should have that same helical trajectory. The overshoot happens in 3D space with the text moving past its target on the Z-axis as well, creating a true spiral effect. This creates a playful, dynamic entrance perfect for creative projects or motion-heavy presentations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center' and style={{ perspective: '800px' }}. TextAtom with transform-origin: center and transform-style: preserve-3d. Complex 3D animation: rotateY from 720deg to -30deg to 0, rotateZ from 180deg to -10deg to 0, translateZ from -200px to 20px to 0, translateX spiral pattern using sine function, scale from 0.5 to 1.1 to 1. Duration: 1.2 seconds with 'ease-out' primary, 'ease-in-out' for settle phase. Add opacity fade from 0 to 1 during first 30%. Apply backface-visibility: hidden and will-change: transform. Consider adding motion blur effect using multiple shadow layers during spin. Perfect for dynamic, energetic content.
